totals.comment: Profile C build, focused 15 cities, 6 products. ~280 indexable pages × 2 locales. Well under doorway-page risk threshold.

internalLinkingModel.homepage: Links to all hubs (products, industries, cities, blog, contact)
internalLinkingModel.productDetail: Links to industries it serves + 6+ city pages (geo cross matrix)
internalLinkingModel.industryDetail: Links to relevant products + city pages
internalLinkingModel.cityDetail: Links to all 6 product geo pages for that city + 2-3 nearby cities
internalLinkingModel.geoCross: Links to city hub + product hub + 2-3 related geo pages + contact
internalLinkingModel.blogPost: Links to relevant products, industries, cities + 1-2 sibling articles
internalLinkingModel.keywordPage: Links to underlying product/industry/city per intent
internalLinkingModel.every: Links to locale alternate via hreflang
